title: Self-service sign-up: a stranger asks for a workspace, with no manual or infra step
description: The owner's acceptance scenario (T-2749, G10b, acceptance map item 11 'self-service demo tenant'). The runner calls the PUBLIC sign-up routes without a token (actor 'anonymous'), with a throwaway address in the mail trap (Mailpit) and a uat-tmp-* company name. Part 1 (this file, runs on today's build): S1 the sign-up is switched on and its config is public; S2 a request without accepted terms is refused 422 invalid_request naming terms_accepted; S3 a request with a malformed address is refused 422; S4 a good request is answered 202 check_your_mail; S5 the verification mail reaches the trap (wait_mail: the body and the token never reach the log). Part 2 (see later_steps) needs the sign-up fields slug, user name and password of T-2748 and the one-time provisioner wiring on QA: until they exist the scenario is RED with a named reason (sign-up not enabled, or provisioner not configured), which is the expected red and no defect. D-195: the scenario goes from the sign-up to a signed-in tenant admin with no step that waits for a human; a step that does is a defect and a red scenario, named in the verdict line. No qoimeks-qa or qoimeks-client1-qa tenant is touched. The verification link is opened by the SPA page, so the runner does not read the body of the mail.
later_steps: L1: POST /api/signup with company name, user name, password and a desired slug (needs the fields of T-2748); 202 and the tenant URL
L2: the runner follows the verification and the provisioning with no human step; D-195: any wait for a human is RED
L3: sign in as the NEW tenant admin (token of the new realm, no secret in the log) and GET /api/v1/me answers 200 with the role TENANT_ADMIN
L4: refusals: slug taken 409/422, a reserved slug 422, the demo cap reached shown as a closed reason
L5: cleanup deactivates the tenant uat-tmp-<run_id> (purge only when T-2747 exists), then the tenant residue check; qoimeks-qa and qoimeks-client1-qa are never touched

steps.says: Anyone may read the public sign-up config: it is switched on and offers the three languages. If it answers 404 the sign-up is not enabled on this build: RED, reason 'sign-up not enabled'.
A request that does not accept the terms is refused 422 and names the field.
A good request is answered 202 check_your_mail, whether or not the address is known.
The verification mail reaches the throwaway address in the mail trap, with no human step. Only recipient, subject and message id are read.
